_note: Appearance + image-generation prompts for the Below the Quiet Docks NPCs. Humanoid ancestries/ages/looks are invented (GM-side, not player canon) and easy to change. Style suffix is shared for a consistent cast. Feed `prompt` to your generator (Flux.2 [dev] via fal.ai now, ComfyUI later); save each as <slug>.webp; then assign with `foundry_macro.py assign-images`.
style: Head-and-shoulders fantasy character portrait, painterly semi-realistic digital illustration, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, dark desaturated vignette background, centered and facing the viewer, sharply detailed face, muted earthy palette, subtle cool rim light, weathered and grounded, no text, no frame, no watermark.
